description: This PHP class file `tuleaprestInterface.class.php` provides an implementation of an issue tracker interface for Tuleap integration within a larger testing and issue management framework. It manages connection setup, status retrieval, issue creation, and note addition by interacting with the Tuleap REST API, defining methods to handle these operations and encapsulating configuration and validation logic specific to Tuleap trackers.

classes.name: tuleaprestInterface
classes.description: A class implementing an issue tracker interface to integrate Tuleap via its REST API, supporting connection management, issue retrieval, creation, and comments.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes and establishes connection to Tuleap tracker using provided configuration, validating tracker ID and URI.

methods.name: getAPIClient
methods.description: Returns the Tuleap API client instance.

methods.name: setResolvedStatusCfg
methods.description: Configures the list of resolved statuses based on tracker data or default settings.

methods.name: getResolvedStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the list of statuses indicating a closed or resolved issue from Tuleap.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve a specific tracker field by ID.

methods.name: getClosedLabels
methods.description: Extracts labels of status values considered closed or resolved.

methods.name: checkTrackerIDSyntax
methods.description: Validates that the tracker ID is a positive integer.

methods.name: checkURLSyntax
methods.description: Validates that the provided URL is well-formed and starts with 'http'.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Validates bug ID syntax, delegating to numeric validation.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to Tuleap API using credentials and configuration, with error handling.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the API connection has been successfully established.

methods.name: buildStatusHTMLString
methods.description: Generates HTML formatted string representing issue status, crossing out resolved statuses.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Fetches the issue details from Tuleap API by issue ID, adding additional HTML formatted attributes.

methods.name: getIssueStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the status code of an issue given its ID.

methods.name: getIssueStatusVerbose
methods.description: Returns a human-readable status string for an issue.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template XML configuration snippet for setting up Tuleap interface.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes missing configuration attributes with defaults based on URI and tracker ID.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks if a bug with given ID exists in Tuleap.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue (artifact) in Tuleap tracker with provided summary and description.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a comment/note to an existing Tuleap issue.

methods.name: canCreateViaAPI
methods.description: Indicates whether issue creation via API is supported based on tracker ID.
